caption: The oracle reply 1010 equals the challenge ciphertext when b = 0 and differs from 0101 when b = 1, so the adversary guesses b' = 0 every time and wins with probability 1. Its advantage is |2·1 − 1| = 1, the maximum, so this deterministic scheme is not IND-CPA; the dashed line is the branch that never shows up.

spec.aria: The adversary asks the oracle for Enc(0000) with key 1010 and gets 1010, then sends m0=0000 and m1=1111 as the challenge; the ciphertext 1010 matches the b=0 branch (0101 is the b=1 branch), so it always guesses b'=0 and the advantage is 1.
